families.topic: public information on meningococcal B vaccination during an outbreak
families.page_title: A guide to the Meningococcal B vaccine that protects against meningitis and septicaemia
evidence_points: The guide explains the meningococcal B vaccine used in an outbreak response.
It states that meningococcal disease is rare but very serious and requires urgent hospital treatment.
It describes possible severe outcomes including hearing loss, brain damage, scars and amputations.
The guide applies to the England outbreak-vaccination programme.
